Frederick stared at the glowing runes, the weight of eternity pressing against his mortal heart. The draft intensified, carrying the scent of ozone and ancient dust. He realized that immortality was not a gift, but a cage—a solitary confinement from which no one could escape. With a trembling hand, he did not reach for the vial of ingredients, but for the torch resting nearby. He cast the flame onto the parchment, watching the secrets of eternal life curl into ash. As the fire consumed the knowledge, the chamber began to collapse, sealing the secret away forever. Frederick walked out into the sunlight, choosing the precious brevity of a human life over an endless, hollow existence.

The explorer who reached America in 1492 is Christopher Columbus.
